title: Results by topic
text: For each task at the largest size each platform ran (memory-limited runners may skip the biggest), each tile is one method’s time relative to the fastest method on that platform (1 = fastest; darker = slower). Timing is median_s (bench::mark median) or, for targets_mech, wall_s (one tar_make()). Read across a row to see whether a method’s rank holds on every platform; absolute times differ between runners. Source: bench-results branch, latest/ (runs 2026-11-09; commits c8ccd93).
